channel.title: The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)" - "It dragged me into my nightmare where it wished for all to feed it's slumbering insanity." Entity inspired by Ole Lukøje.

item.title: Re: The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)
item.content:encoded:
I was summoned by IRC Chat. Let's crit this.

[+] Here, have some crit
[-] OK, now give me back my crit

Right of the bat, why don't you have the Seeking greenlight, Page Type, Genre, and Page Layout sections? Those don't add up to the word limit, and you should add them so reviewers know if you want greenlights, what type of page you want, what genre you're aiming for, etc.

Now, let's do the actual crit:

This humanoid makes any person they encounter a narcoleptic

Please specify if the humanoid chooses a person or it just affects anyone they encounter. I think it would be difficult for it to affect everyone. And if they chooses a person, does the person need to have any characteristics or it's just random?

they are lured into a sense of security before being murdered and/or eaten alive

Why? As I'm aware, the Ole Lukøje only punishes bad children. Why does this entity attacks people? Is it for food, fun, punishment…?

Central Narrative:

So my concern with your narrative is that it seems to have an escessive amount of references to the original story of the Ole Lukøje. While you can write something based off a fairy tale, you need to put some kind of twist to it, otherwise it would be just the same thing with the SCP logo slapped to it.

"The Ole Lukøje but now it's evil" isn't a good twist, at leat on my perspective. It seems cliché to just take a character and make it evil for no reason. Maybe you could write why did the Ole Lukøje become evil? Maybe an interview with the entity could clarify this? Maybe the researchers recognize him from old folktales and they are curious on why he is killing people now?

The other thing that concerns me is that all of your narrative is backstory. It's not wrong to focus on the backstory, but the only thing you're telling is how it came to Foundation custody. What happened after? I think an interview with the entity could improve your story.

Also, the “it killed me and it’ll kill you again" has no relation to what the SCP does after you wake up they were just spouting nonsense due to their new psychotic nature.

I think MTF members would be a lot more calm when waking up of a dream like this. Sure, they're afraid to die, but they're trained to face things like this. Maybe they would be worried and nervous, but they wouldn't be screaming like that.

Overall, I like stories based off pieces of literature, but I think this needs some kind of in-deep twist to differentiate it from the original story.

Feel free to contact a member of the Butterfly Squad to get more crit, or PM me to take another look.

item.title: Re: The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)
item.content:encoded: He doesn't die in the dream or when he first hits the floor. He is still alive in his dream even when his frontal lobe is crushed. You can't die when the Sandman is devouring you but the injuries that happened in the dream will happen in the real world 3 to 8 hours after the subject wakes. But even then the foundation wouldn't know about so thank you for the idea of making it a tale. Thanks for the feedback!!!

item.title: Re: The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)
item.content:encoded:
Note: Not a verified reviewer.

Reading your Central Narrative, I found myself asking this question: How does the Foundation know any of this? If the man dies after being affected by the anomaly, and everything prior to him going crazy happens in a dream, how would the Foundation find it out? Remember, we're supposed to see this all happen from the Foundation's perspective, not the victim's. If you want to include it all, I suggest you write a tale instead (which would obviously require a little tweaking in terms of the anomaly and all).

item.title: The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)
item.content:encoded:
Elevator Pitch: A horrific humanoid that can only be seen using UV rays. This humanoid makes any person they encounter a narcoleptic, anyone affected by the humanoid will be stalked until they fall asleep which they will then enter the Sandman’s dreamscape where they are lured into a sense of security before being murdered and/or eaten alive gruesomely through mutilation. The subject of this encounter will be conscious the whole time while they’re unable to escape as it slowly eats and/or mutilates the subject causing them to become psychotic. When the subject wakes up within the next few hours all the injuries they sustained in their dream will become a reality.

Central Narrative: On 9/14/15 48-year-old male Christian Andersen was arrested for the gruesome murder and mutilation of his wife and 2 children. During interrogation Andersen spontaneously mutilated which and immediately afterward 2 officers within the vicinity suddenly fell asleep. This alerted the foundation to possible anomalous activity in the Østerbro district of Copenhagen, Denmark. After evacuating and securing the district 2 MTF members suddenly fell asleep and upon their awakening, they were yelling and screaming “IT KILLED ME AND IT’LL KILL YOU AGAIN!” The 2 MTF agents were detained in a humanoid containment chamber and were then interviewed. It was stated that a humanoid with a split jaw ravaged and ate them alive. One of the MTF agents screamed out in pain and died instantly, showing signs of severe internal bleeding. When dissected it was discovered that his internal organs were missing or mutilated. On 9/19/15 at 3:55 pm a humanoid with the traits the deceased MTF agent stated was spotted at Amager Strandpark and was later contained by an MTF squadron.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: "It dragged me into my nightmare where it wished for all to feed its slumbering insanity."

Additional Notes: Format would be ConProcs, Description, then an Addendum or two where you could put, like, accounts of a victim's experience or stuff. Also, the “it killed me and it’ll kill you again" has no relation to what the SCP does after you wake up they were just spouting nonsense due to their new psychotic nature.
